mapper.formula:
AND(
  OR("{{62.`38`}}" != "", "{{62.`39`}}" != ""), 
  OR(
    LOWER({Company Name}) = LOWER("{{62.`38`}}"),
    SUBSTITUTE(
      SUBSTITUTE(
        SUBSTITUTE({Website}, "https://", ""), 
      "http://", ""), 
    "www.", "") 
    = 
    SUBSTITUTE(
      SUBSTITUTE(
        SUBSTITUTE("{{62.`39`}}", "https://", ""), 
      "http://", ""), 
    "www.", "")
  )
)
